description:
## Problem

`OctoPi.TUI.Terminal.KeyParser` only handles `\x1b[H` / `\x1b[F` and SS3 forms (`\x1bOH` / `\x1bOF`) for Home/End. macOS Terminal.app and most modern terminals send the **VT-style sequences** `\x1b[1~` (Home) and `\x1b[4~` (End), which our parser returns as `unknown`.

**Verified live in tmux** — telemetry trace from `mix pi --log-telemetry=/tmp/pi_trace.log` after pressing Home and End:
```
seq=[1~ parsed=unknown
seq=[4~ parsed=unknown
```
`ctrl+a` / `ctrl+e` work correctly, masking the issue until you actually press the dedicated Home/End keys.

## Files to modify

- `apps/octo_pi_tui_terminal/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal/key_parser.ex` — existing similar entries: `legacy_csi("H")` / `legacy_csi("F")` at lines 110-111, modifier forms (`7$`, `8$`, `7^`, `8^`) at lines 150-157.
  - Add `legacy_csi("1~")` returning `%Key{key: :home}`.
  - Add `legacy_csi("4~")` returning `%Key{key: :end}`.
  - Optionally add the alternate VT forms `\x1b[7~` (home) and `\x1b[8~` (end) — upstream accepts these too. See `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/keys.ts:373-374`:
    ```
    home: ["\x1b[H", "\x1bOH", "\x1b[1~", "\x1b[7~"],
    end:  ["\x1b[F", "\x1bOF", "\x1b[4~", "\x1b[8~"],
    ```
- Mirror modifier forms (`tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/keys.ts:404, 418` for shift/ctrl) if the existing octo_pi parser doesn't already handle them under different sequences. Confirm the gap with a grep before adding.

## Acceptance

- Pressing Home/End in `mix pi` moves the cursor to line start/end (verifiable in tmux with a sentinel-character probe: send Home, type `|`, see `|hello world` instead of `h|ello world`).
- Telemetry trace shows `parsed=%OctoPi.TUI.Key{key: :home}` (or `:end`) for the `[1~` / `[4~` sequences instead of `parsed=unknown`.
- Tests cover all four primary sequence forms per key (`[H`/`OH`/`[1~`/`[7~` for Home, `[F`/`OF`/`[4~`/`[8~` for End) — see upstream behavior at `keys.ts:996-1016`.

## Blast radius

Parser-only. No callers change. Smallest of the foundation tickets.

## Notes for the next agent

Don't trust documentation over implementation. Read `apps/octo_pi_tui_terminal/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal/key_parser.ex` directly to understand the existing dispatch shape before adding clauses. Memory rule: when something doesn't work as expected, read the implementation first.
title: Fix Home/End VT-style key parser sequences
